plannedShots.description: Push in on house, past passing BUTTERFLY, through window, right over spinning record player, to ABBY at sink in distance

plannedShots.description: ABBY at the sink. Tears slowly form in her eyes. Can extend to :27 if works as one shot.
plannedShots.action: Leans at sink, eyes welling up

plannedShots.description: Teardrop falls from ABBY's eye and lands in water, causing a ripple on still water, which bumps teacup
plannedShots.action: Leans at sink, eyes welling up

plannedShots.description: IMAGINATION pokes her head out of the teacup and looks around as teardrops fall and the teacup is rocked
plannedShots.action: Pokes head up, steadies herself by holding sides of teacup, looks up and around as teacup rocks
plannedShots.fileName: 1C_1E A 1110 abby in teacup flat ocean.c4d

plannedShots.description: IMAGINATION beholds the falling teardrops, which rock her teacup
plannedShots.action: Looks up and around as teacup rocks
plannedShots.fileName: 1D A 1110 abby in teacup flat ocean cu.c4d

plannedShots.action: Rocked into side of teacup
